text.p: Following are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Thursday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Alexandrs Lavents, the former owner of the collapsed bank Baltija, and the bank's president Talis Freimanis were officially charged by the prosecutor's office.

- The leaders of the Latvian Environment Protection Club question the results an environmental impact study carried out by the Norwegian company Det Norske Veritas Industrie AS for Lithuania's Butinge oil terminal.
- The World Bank considers Latvia to be the leader of social reforms in Eastern Europe.
- Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs continues his visit to Vietnam.

- Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, meeting with Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson, says Russia is ready to use all its economic leverage to improve the situation of the Russian-speaking population in the Baltic states.
- Latvia and Russia will today resume talks on delimitation of the land border.
